integrity: All proofs and computational comparisons pertain to the same specified claim. Finite checks are not used in place of the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact sparse-minority subsequence enumeration only. The integer extremal maximum is established asymptotically, not exactly at all lengths. Global originality is not independently certified; close comparison to finite contiguous factors and unrestricted enumerations is described in the manuscript.
title: Exact scattered abelian-square spectrum and cubic extremizers for two-marked binary words
